messages:
Maria (Finance): FYI, vendor CloudRack sent a late APAC invoice (PO 8892) for Jan/Feb reserved capacity. This will push ~ $120k into unbilled for March. Need rev rec guidance for month close.
Alex (Revenue): Can you attach invoice scan? Is this prepay/commit or overage? If prepay, we might need to defer and adjust schedule.
Maria (Finance): It's a prepay amendment — customer got a credit applied late. Invoice amount 120,345 USD, allocated to APAC prepay bucket. Scanned PDF: https://files.example.com/cloudrack_8892.pdf
Taylor (Billing Ops): Confirmed — vendor posted on 2026-03-22 PST. Billing system shows allocation to customer ACME-APAC commit.
Alex (Revenue): For month-end, we need a proposed journal. Suggest: DR Unbilled Revenue 120,345 / CR Deferred Revenue 120,345, then monthly amortization per schedule. Need controller sign-off.
Jamal (Controller): Agree in principle. Need estimate of service period — do we amortize over remaining 10 months or the original 12?
Maria (Finance): Original prepay term was 12 months starting 2026-01-01. Vendor adjustment applies retroactively to Jan/Feb; remaining service = 10 months starting 2026-03-01.
Taylor (Billing Ops): Also note pricing-experiment promo credits were applied to same account in Feb — ~15% discount. That affects gross vs net presentation. @Olivia any thoughts from Sales?
Olivia (Sales): Promo was a product-led credit; we treat as contra-revenue per policy. Finance to handle presentation. Customer approved amendment on 2026-03-10.
Alex (Revenue): Need two entries: 1) Recognize vendor invoice into unbilled/deferred as Maria suggested; 2) Post a contra-revenue credit for the promo 18,052. Total net deferral = 102,293. I'll send amortization schedule.
Maria (Finance): Can someone approve manual JE in NetSuite? I'll prepare supporting memo and attach invoice + approval chain.
Jamal (Controller): Approve posting subject to memo and traceability. @reconcile-bot please create task in month-close queue.
reconcile-bot: Task created: "Manual JE — CloudRack late invoice 8892" due 2026-03-25. link: https://tasks.example.com/1234 :white_check_mark:
Alex (Revenue): One quick ask — impact to recognized ARR? This pushes recognized revenue down this quarter by ~24k. Tagging growth: @Nina (Finance Ops) FYI.
Nina (Finance Ops): Thx. Will update forecast model post-JE and send revised revenue waterfall.
Maria (Finance): I'll send JE draft by EOD. Need controller signature and finance head approval before close.
Olivia (Sales): Noted. Do we need to notify customer billing team? They were already CC'd on amendment.
Taylor (Billing Ops): No external notification needed — internal accounting correction only.
Maria (Finance): Closing checklist: 1) JE draft 2) Memo with invoice + promo detail 3) Controller sign-off 4) Post JE 3/24 5) Update forecast. Anyone object?
All: No objections. :thumbsup:
Maria (Finance): Thanks, I'll file attachments here once uploaded.
